mapper.select: SELECT t.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, t.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, t.previous_score AS previousScore, t.current_score AS currentScore, (t.previous_score - t.current_score) AS dropAmount, CASE WHEN (t.previous_score - t.current_score) >= 30 THEN 'RED' WHEN (t.previous_score - t.current_score) >= 20 THEN 'ORANGE' ELSE 'YELLOW' END AS alertLevel FROM ( SELECT student_id, course_id, score AS current_score, LAG(score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, course_id ORDER BY exam_time, create_time) AS previous_score FROM score ) t INNER JOIN student st ON t.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.id WHERE t.previous_score IS NOT NULL AND (t.previous_score - t.current_score) > 15 ORDER BY (t.previous_score - t.current_score) DESC

SELECT #{classId} AS classId, COUNT(*) AS studentCount, ROUND(AVG(t.score), 2) AS avgScore, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.rn IN (t.cnt DIV 2 + 1, (t.cnt + 1) DIV 2) THEN t.score END), 2) AS medianScore, ROUND(STDDEV(t.score), 2) AS stdDev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS passRate, MAX(t.score) AS maxScore, MIN(t.score) AS minScore FROM ( SELECT s.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id WHERE st.class_id = #{classId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} ) t
